races.note: Open seat (Daines withdrew). Three-way race: Kurt Alme (R) vs. independent Seth Bodnar, with Democrat Alani Bankhead still on the ballot (about 20% in polls) and Libertarian Kyle Austin. Margin shown is Alme vs. Bodnar, as a share of their two votes. Polls are entered by hand because the automated feed mislabeled some full-field results. Sponsored polls (Concord for a Democratic-aligned group, Peak for Alme, Aspect for a pro-Bodnar PAC) count half.
